title: Clerk card illustrations
description: Quiet, skeuomorphic mock illustrations for feature cards, built from divs and lucide icons: code boxes that fill on hover, an alert pill over a dotted timeline, a fingerprint dial, a device sheet, orbiting provider icons, a radar spotlight, a phone app grid, a scrambled token over a profile tile, a keyhole dial, a server rack with a status pill, a node graph, a role grid, an auto-join tree, an invite pill and an org switcher.
notes: made for clerk-card: they fill the card's illustration area and animate on the card's hover
all colour comes from tokens; they read best on the clerk theme's dark band but work on light themes too
name: clerk-art
